scientific_limitations: The distributional and sharp mean-width laws require both bipartition proportions to have positive limits; sparse-part regimes are not asserted.
A prior equivalent expression phrased solely in Gaussian order-statistics may exist; absolute bibliographic novelty is not claimed.
Finite computational diagnostics do not substitute for the analytic extreme-value and moment arguments.
No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
title: A sharp Gaussian mean-width loss for complete-bipartite symmetric edge polytopes
